```{=html}
<style>
.w073 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.w073 .w073-cols { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w073 .w073-col { flex: 1 1 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.w073 .w073-item {
  position: relative; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none; font-size: 0.85rem;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w073 .w073-item.w073-term { font-weight: 700; text-align: center; border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w073 .w073-item.w073-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w073 .w073-item.w073-done { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }
.w073 .w073-item.w073-flash { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; background: rgba(216, 30, 46, 0.15); }
.w073 .w073-badge {
  position: absolute; top: -9px; right: -6px; background: #2e7d32; color: #fff;
  border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 0 6px;
}
.w073 .w073-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w073 .w073-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w073 .w073-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w073 .w073-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w073 .w073-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w073 .w073-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
</style>
<div class="w073 iw" id="w073">
  <div class="w073-cols">
    <div class="w073-col w073-terms" aria-label="terms"></div>
    <div class="w073-col w073-defs" aria-label="descriptions"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="w073-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w073-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w073-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w073-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w073-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w073-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w073');
  const termCol = root.querySelector('.w073-terms');
  const defCol = root.querySelector('.w073-defs');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w073-msg');
  const PAIRS = [
    ['Entity', 'A unique actor: a person, device, application or system'],
    ['Identity', 'The entity’s verifiable expression within a namespace; one entity may hold several'],
    ['Authentication', 'The process of verifying an identity'],
    ['Authorisation', 'The decision to permit or deny an authenticated identity access to a resource'],
    ['Entitlement', 'The mapping of identities to authorisations, often with conditions; a table of these is reviewed for least privilege']
  ];
  const RIGHT = [2, 4, 0, 1, 3]; // fixed scrambled order of definitions (none aligned)
  let picked = null;

  function items() { return [...root.querySelectorAll('.w073-item')]; }
  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w073-picked');
    picked = null;
  }
  function clearMsg() { msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w073-msg iw-msg'; }
  function badge(el) {
    const b = document.createElement('span');
    b.className = 'w073-badge';
    b.textContent = String(Number(el.dataset.k) + 1);
    el.appendChild(b);
  }
  function lock(a, b) {
    [a, b].forEach(el => { el.classList.add('w073-done'); el.draggable = false; badge(el); });
  }
  function attempt(a, b) {
    unpick(); clearMsg();
    if (a.dataset.k === b.dataset.k) { lock(a, b); return; }
    [a, b].forEach(el => {
      el.classList.add('w073-flash');
      setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('w073-flash'), 650);
    });
  }
  function sideOf(el) { return el.classList.contains('w073-term') ? 't' : 'd'; }
  function makeItem(text, k, isTerm) {
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'w073-item' + (isTerm ? ' w073-term' : ' w073-def');
    el.textContent = text;
    el.dataset.k = String(k);
    el.draggable = true;
    el.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (el.classList.contains('w073-done')) return;
      if (picked === el) { unpick(); return; }
      if (picked && sideOf(picked) !== sideOf(el)) { attempt(picked, el); return; }
      unpick(); picked = el; el.classList.add('w073-picked');
    });
    el.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {
      if (el.classList.contains('w073-done')) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
      unpick();
      e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', sideOf(el) + ':' + el.dataset.k);
    });
    el.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    el.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      if (el.classList.contains('w073-done')) return;
      const [s, k] = (e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') || '').split(':');
      if (!s || s === sideOf(el)) return;
      const other = root.querySelector('.w073-item.w073-' + (s === 't' ? 'term' : 'def') + '[data-k="' + k + '"]');
      if (other && !other.classList.contains('w073-done')) attempt(other, el);
    });
    return el;
  }
  function matchedCount() {
    return root.querySelectorAll('.w073-term.w073-done').length;
  }
  root.querySelector('.w073-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick();
    const n = matchedCount();
    if (n === PAIRS.length) {
      msg.textContent = '✓ All ' + PAIRS.length + ' pairs matched — the vocabulary of the new perimeter.';
      msg.className = 'w073-msg iw-msg ok';
    } else {
      msg.textContent = n + ' of ' + PAIRS.length + ' pairs matched — keep going (a wrong attempt flashes red).';
      msg.className = 'w073-msg iw-msg';
    }
  });
  function resetAll() {
    unpick();
    items().forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('w073-done', 'w073-flash');
      el.draggable = true;
      const b = el.querySelector('.w073-badge');
      if (b) b.remove();
    });
    RIGHT.forEach(k => defCol.appendChild(defCol.querySelector('.w073-def[data-k="' + k + '"]')));
    clearMsg();
  }
  root.querySelector('.w073-reset').addEventListener('click', resetAll);
  root.querySelector('.w073-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    resetAll();
    PAIRS.forEach((p, k) => {
      const t = termCol.querySelector('.w073-term[data-k="' + k + '"]');
      const d = defCol.querySelector('.w073-def[data-k="' + k + '"]');
      defCol.appendChild(d);
      lock(t, d);
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w073-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  PAIRS.forEach((p, k) => termCol.appendChild(makeItem(p[0], k, true)));
  RIGHT.forEach(k => defCol.appendChild(makeItem(PAIRS[k][1], k, false)));
})();
</script>
```
